newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banacci shares down on Banamex earnings.
newsitem.headline: Banacci shares down on Banamex earnings.

text.p: Shares of Mexican financial group Banamex-Accival (Banacci) were lower in midday trade following weak nine-month results for its bank unit Banamex, traders said.
Banacci's benchmark B shares were down 3.52 percent on moderate volume of 450,000 shares traded.
"The bank's third quarter results were disappointing," one Mexico City trader said.
"It appears the margins at the bank were weak and that is causing some worry," another trader said.
Banamex reported nine-month net profits of 1.894 billion pesos, up 28 percent versus the same period last year. It did not give margins on Banamex.
